caption: MCP Observation
description: What an event observed of a Model Context Protocol interaction, kept apart from the shared tool fields it also fills: the protocol revision with how it was established (never inferred from a CLI or SDK version), the addressed server and tool with an independent basis for each (a dispatcher's own name and arguments stay in tool_name and arguments), and the protocol objects the source reported, each typed by the pinned binding and labelled complete, a partial CLI projection or a schema example. Absent means no MCP fact was established, not that the call was not MCP.
name: mcp_observation

basis.description: How the MCP facts on this observation were established from the source.
